description: Zeck environment variable contract (Deployment Roadmap D-01). Non-secret configuration variables only. Credential-shaped values never appear here: infrastructure credentials enter exclusively as zeck-secret:// references held in ZECK_SECRET_*_REF variables (see secret-references.json, which this manifest cross-references). Every variable declares its name, type, scope and whether its value is credential-shaped (environment-only storage, never committed).

variables.name: ZECK_ENVIRONMENT
variables.description: The environment identity this process or tool invocation represents.

variables.name: ZECK_DEPLOY_GIT_REVISION
variables.description: Exact Git revision for deployment identity computation. Defaults to the repository HEAD of the working tree.

variables.name: ZECK_SECRET_DATABASE_URL_REF
variables.description: Reference to the environment's PostgreSQL connection string. The reference URI is non-secret; the materialized value never is.

variables.name: ZECK_SECRET_OBJECT_STORE_ACCESS_KEY_ID_REF
variables.description: Reference to the environment's R2 access key id.

variables.name: ZECK_SECRET_OBJECT_STORE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY_REF
variables.description: Reference to the environment's R2 secret access key.

variables.name: ZECK_SECRET_QUEUE_API_TOKEN_REF
variables.description: Reference to the environment's Cloudflare Queues API token.

variables.name: ZECK_SECRET_WORKFLOW_API_TOKEN_REF
variables.description: Reference to the environment's Cloudflare Workflows API token.

variables.name: ZECK_SECRET_REDIS_REST_URL_REF
variables.description: Reference to the environment's Upstash Redis REST URL.

variables.name: ZECK_SECRET_REDIS_REST_TOKEN_REF
variables.description: Reference to the environment's Upstash Redis REST token.

variables.name: ZECK_SECRET_EXPERIENCE_DEPLOY_TOKEN_REF
variables.description: Reference to the environment's Vercel deployment token.

variables.name: ZECK_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
variables.description: Cloudflare account identifier. Non-secret provider-account metadata: an account locator, not a credential. Classified as provider-account metadata that cannot be reproduced from the repository.

variables.name: ZECK_LOCAL_DATA_ROOT
variables.description: Root directory for local disposable resources. Defaults to ~/.local/share/zeck. Never inside the repository.

variables.name: ZECK_PG_ADMIN_URL
variables.description: Local PostgreSQL admin connection string used by bootstrap/teardown to create and drop the disposable zeck_local database. Credential-shaped: environment-only storage, never committed.

variables.name: ZECK_PG_TEST_URL
variables.description: PostgreSQL connection string consumed by the test suite (integration harness). Credential-shaped: environment-only storage, never committed.

variables.name: ZECK_LOCAL_REDIS_URL
variables.description: Local Redis-compatible service URL for coordination smoke checks. Absent, the local smoke reports the explicit coordination-degraded mode.

variables.name: ZECK_API_URL
variables.description: Control-plane API base URL used by the dashboard experience client.

variables.name: ZECK_APPLICATION_ID
variables.description: Application id whose scope authorizes the dashboard's governed reads.

variables.name: ZECK_TOKEN
variables.description: Dashboard API bearer credential. Credential-shaped: environment-only storage, never committed. Application-level credential; infrastructure credentials use secret references instead.

variables.name: DASHBOARD_PORT
variables.description: Local dashboard listen port. Defaults to 4545.

variables.name: ZECK_DATABASE_URL
variables.description: Materialized value of the environment's database-url secret (the managed PostgreSQL connection string, e.g. a Neon endpoint with sslmode=require). Credential-shaped: environment-only storage, never committed. The non-secret reference binding is ZECK_SECRET_DATABASE_URL_REF; resolution happens immediately before the authorized database adapter call (src/platform/secret-store/adapters/env-secret-store.ts).

variables.name: ZECK_OBJECT_STORE_ACCESS_KEY_ID
variables.description: Materialized value of the environment's object-store-access-key-id secret (the R2 S3 access key id). Credential-shaped: environment-only storage, never committed. The non-secret reference binding is ZECK_SECRET_OBJECT_STORE_ACCESS_KEY_ID_REF.

variables.name: ZECK_OBJECT_STORE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
variables.description: Materialized value of the environment's object-store-secret-access-key secret (the R2 S3 secret access key). Credential-shaped: environment-only storage, never committed. The non-secret reference binding is ZECK_SECRET_OBJECT_STORE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY_REF.

variables.name: ZECK_OBJECT_STORE_ENDPOINT
variables.description: S3-compatible object-store endpoint for the artifact-bytes port (Cloudflare R2: https://<account-id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com). Ordinary non-secret configuration; the account id is separately declared as ZECK_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.

variables.name: ZECK_OBJECT_STORE_BUCKET
variables.description: S3-compatible bucket name behind the ObjectStore port. Ordinary non-secret configuration; smoke cross-checks it against the manifest-computed resource name for the environment.

variables.name: ZECK_OBJECT_STORE_REGION
variables.description: SigV4 region for the S3-compatible object store. Cloudflare R2 uses the 'auto' region; the repository default is 'auto'.

variables.name: ZECK_QUEUE_ID
variables.description: Cloudflare queue id (the 32-hex REST resource id) for the environment's dispatch queue behind the queue transport port. Ordinary non-secret provider-resource configuration; the queue name is deterministic from deploy/manifests/resources.json (kind cf-queue) and the id is resolved at provisioning time.

variables.name: ZECK_PROBE_QUEUE_ID
variables.description: Cloudflare queue id (the 32-hex REST resource id) of the DEDICATED operator-owned probe queue used by the transport round-trip verification (deploy:smoke and deploy:queue probe). Must be a queue reserved for probe traffic and MUST differ from ZECK_QUEUE_ID (equal values are rejected fail-closed): probe traffic never enters the execution queue, and the probe acknowledges only its own exact message, so unrelated execution deliveries can never be consumed, discarded or delayed by a probe. The probe queue carries no application state and is not part of the environment's authoritative resource inventory; provision it with an HTTP pull consumer and the same token scopes (queues_read + queues_write).

variables.name: ZECK_QUEUE_API_BASE_URL
variables.description: Queue transport REST API base URL override. Defaults to https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4; override only for local protocol gateways in verification.

variables.name: ZECK_QUEUE_API_TOKEN
variables.description: Materialized value of the environment's queue-api-token secret (the Cloudflare API token with queues read+write for the environment's queue). Credential-shaped: environment-only storage, never committed. The non-secret reference binding is ZECK_SECRET_QUEUE_API_TOKEN_REF; resolution happens immediately before the authorized queue adapter call (src/platform/secret-store/adapters/env-secret-store.ts).

variables.name: ZECK_QUEUE_MAX_PUBLISH_ATTEMPTS
variables.description: Maximum publish attempts for one dispatch envelope before the dispatch becomes backlogged (explicit, recoverable). Repository default 3; bounded [1,100]; no unbounded publication retries exist.

variables.name: ZECK_QUEUE_MAX_DELIVERY_ATTEMPTS
variables.description: Maximum delivery attempts for one transport message before an explicit dead letter. Repository default 3; bounded [1,100]; retry exhaustion is always explicit and inspectable.

variables.name: ZECK_QUEUE_MAX_REPLAYS
variables.description: Maximum replays issued from one root dispatch lineage (bounded replay re-entry of the governed execution path). Repository default 3; bounded [1,100].

variables.name: ZECK_QUEUE_RETRY_BACKOFF_MS
variables.description: Base backoff in milliseconds for the deterministic linear retry schedule (attempt * base, capped at 60s). Repository default 500.

variables.name: ZECK_QUEUE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.description: Per-request timeout for queue transport HTTP calls. Bounded [100,120000]; default 10000.

variables.name: ZECK_WORKFLOW_NAME
variables.description: Cloudflare Workflows name (the deployed workflow script name, up to 64 characters) the environment's orchestration instances run on, behind the workflow orchestration port. Ordinary non-secret provider-resource configuration; the name is deterministic from deploy/manifests/resources.json (kind cf-workflow) and resolved at deployment time. See deploy/README.md for the workflow-code contract.

variables.name: ZECK_WORKFLOW_PROBE_NAME
variables.description: Cloudflare Workflows name of the DEDICATED operator-owned probe workflow used by the orchestration round-trip verification (deploy:smoke and deploy:workflow probe). Must be a workflow reserved for probe traffic and MUST differ from ZECK_WORKFLOW_NAME (equal values are rejected fail-closed): the probe never targets the orchestration workflow, and it only ever creates, observes and terminates its own exact instance, so application orchestration can never be consumed, discarded or delayed by a probe. The probe workflow carries no application state and is not part of the environment's authoritative resource inventory.

variables.name: ZECK_WORKFLOW_API_BASE_URL
variables.description: Workflow orchestration REST API base URL override. Defaults to https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4; override only for local protocol gateways in verification.

variables.name: ZECK_WORKFLOW_API_TOKEN
variables.description: Materialized value of the environment's workflow-api-token secret (the Cloudflare API token with Workflows write for the environment's workflow). Credential-shaped: environment-only storage, never committed. The non-secret reference binding is ZECK_SECRET_WORKFLOW_API_TOKEN_REF; resolution happens immediately before the authorized workflow adapter call (src/platform/secret-store/adapters/env-secret-store.ts).

variables.name: ZECK_WORKFLOW_MAX_START_ATTEMPTS
variables.description: Maximum provider instance-start attempts for one orchestration wait before the wait becomes deferred (explicit, recoverable — the declared orchestration-paused degradation). Repository default 3; bounded [1,100]; no unbounded instance starts exist.

variables.name: ZECK_WORKFLOW_MAX_SIGNAL_ATTEMPTS
variables.description: Maximum provider-signal delivery attempts for one resolving notification before delivery stops (the wait is already settled authoritatively; the compaction run terminates the lingering instance). Repository default 3; bounded [1,100].

variables.name: ZECK_WORKFLOW_MAX_EFFECT_ATTEMPTS
variables.description: Maximum governed-effect application attempts for one wait resolution (transient failures only; permanent governed refusals land immediately as abandoned waits with the exact reason). Repository default 3; bounded [1,100].

variables.name: ZECK_WORKFLOW_MAX_REPLACEMENTS
variables.description: Maximum replacements issued from one orchestration wait lineage (bounded re-arm of abandoned/superseded waits; the root lineage budget). Repository default 3; bounded [1,100].

variables.name: ZECK_WORKFLOW_RETRY_BACKOFF_MS
variables.description: Base backoff in milliseconds for the deterministic linear retry schedule (attempt * base, capped at 60s) across instance starts, signal deliveries and effect applications. Repository default 500.

variables.name: ZECK_WORKFLOW_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES
variables.description: Maximum canonical bytes for orchestration pointer/signal payloads (reference-only: ids, keys, digests). Repository default 4096; bounded [256,65536]; large artifact bytes and secret values never enter workflow state — enforced fail-closed before any wire call.

variables.name: ZECK_WORKFLOW_MAX_RETAINED_NOTIFICATIONS
variables.description: Maximum notification rows retained per wait before refused/stale notifications fold into the durable folded_notifications counter (bounded, inspectable orchestration state). Repository default 32; bounded [1,10000].

variables.name: ZECK_WORKFLOW_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.description: Per-request timeout for workflow orchestration HTTP calls. Bounded [100,120000]; default 10000.

variables.name: ZECK_WORKFLOW_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.description: Default wait deadline in milliseconds applied when arming orchestration waits (the deadline elapses through the governed expiration path — never by the provider's clock). 0 disables the deadline (the wait resolves only by notification); bounded [0,2592000000] (30 days); repository default 0.

variables.name: ZECK_WORKER_LEASE_TTL_MS
variables.description: Execution-lease TTL granted per worker claim acquisition (milliseconds). Repository default 60000; bounded [1000,3600000]. The lease is the executions module's single fencing system; a stale worker can never commit an authoritative effect.

variables.name: ZECK_WORKER_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS
variables.description: Worker registration/claim heartbeat and lease-renewal cadence (milliseconds). Repository default 5000; bounded [100,60000]. Heartbeat loss beyond ZECK_WORKER_STALE_AFTER_MS makes the worker offline and its claims recoverable.

variables.name: ZECK_WORKER_DEFAULT_ENV_QUOTA
variables.description: Default per-compute-environment concurrent live-claim quota (applied when no explicit quota row exists; per-environment overrides live in compute_plane.environment_quotas). Repository default 8; bounded [1,512].

variables.name: ZECK_WORKER_MAX_CLAIM_ATTEMPTS
variables.description: Maximum worker claim attempts per execution (bounded re-selection; exhaustion records the honest governed failure through the executions authority). Repository default 3; bounded [1,10].

variables.name: ZECK_WORKER_MAX_IN_FLIGHT
variables.description: Maximum concurrent in-flight work items per worker process (the registration's declared concurrency; also physically enforced as live claims per worker). Repository default 4; bounded [1,128].

variables.name: ZECK_WORKER_MAX_DRAIN_MS
variables.description: Bounded drain deadline on worker shutdown (stop accepting new work; in-flight items converge or are abandoned recoverable for fresh workers). Repository default 120000; bounded [1000,600000].

variables.name: ZECK_WORKER_CLAIM_VISIBILITY_MS
variables.description: Queue visibility window for the claim-acquisition pull (milliseconds): the message is the wake-up; the durable claim + lease carry the work after admission. Repository default 30000; bounded [1000,600000].

variables.name: ZECK_WORKER_BATCH_SIZE
variables.description: Maximum dispatch deliveries pulled per worker poll batch. Repository default 8; bounded [1,32].

variables.name: ZECK_WORKER_STALE_AFTER_MS
variables.description: A worker registration (or live claim) whose heartbeat age exceeds this bound is swept offline (worker) / abandoned (claim) by the recovery scan. Repository default 90000; bounded [1000,3600000].

variables.name: ZECK_WORKER_MAX_OUTCOME_BYTES
variables.description: Maximum canonical bytes for worker-claim outcome/detail payloads (reference-only: ids, keys, digests, bounded reasons). Repository default 2048; bounded [128,8192].

variables.name: ZECK_WORKER_CLAIM_RETENTION_MS
variables.description: Retention window for TERMINAL claim rows of terminal executions before compaction removes them (bounded retained worker metadata). Repository default 604800000 (7 days); bounded [3600000,7776000000].

variables.name: ZECK_CONTAINER_RUNNER_URL
variables.description: Base URL of the container runner daemon implementing the documented Zeck container-runner REST protocol (deploy/README.md D-05) behind the platform ContainerRuntimeClient. The worker's container ComputeEnvironment fails closed without it — unisolated execution is never a fallback.

variables.name: ZECK_CONTAINER_RUNNER_API_TOKEN
variables.description: Materialized value of the environment's container-runner token (the runner daemon's bearer credential). Credential-shaped: environment-only storage, never committed. The non-secret reference binding is ZECK_SECRET_CONTAINER_RUNNER_TOKEN_REF; resolution happens immediately before the authorized runner call.

variables.name: ZECK_CONTAINER_RUNNER_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.description: Per-request timeout for container-runner HTTP calls. Bounded [100,120000]; default 10000.

variables.name: ZECK_CONTAINER_RUNNER_POLL_INTERVAL_MS
variables.description: Poll interval while observing an executing container run. Bounded [50,5000]; default 250.

variables.name: ZECK_CONTAINER_RUNNER_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES
variables.description: Bounded stdout/stderr payload size for container-run observations (bytes; truncated deterministically on the boundary). Bounded [256,65536]; default 4096.

variables.name: ZECK_SECRET_CONTAINER_RUNNER_TOKEN_REF
variables.description: Reference to the environment's container-runner token (the runner daemon's bearer credential behind the platform ContainerRuntimeClient).

variables.name: ZECK_OTLP_ENDPOINT
variables.description: Base URL of the OpenTelemetry-compatible collector receiving OTLP/HTTP-JSON traces, metrics and logs (any self-hosted or managed OTLP endpoint). Unset is the declared logs-only degraded mode — never an error.

variables.name: ZECK_OTLP_AUTH_TOKEN
variables.description: Materialized value of the environment's OTLP collector bearer token. Credential-shaped: environment-only storage, never committed, never logged. The non-secret reference binding is ZECK_SECRET_OTLP_AUTH_TOKEN_REF; resolution happens immediately before the authorized export call.

variables.name: ZECK_OTLP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.description: Per-request timeout for OTLP export calls. Bounded [100,120000]; default 5000.

variables.name: ZECK_TELEMETRY_FLUSH_EVERY
variables.description: Buffered telemetry records before a sink flush. Bounded [8,512]; default 50. Buffer maxima, attribute counts, value lengths, message lengths and export batches are hard-bounded constants in the observability port (an unbounded policy is unrepresentable).

variables.name: ZECK_SECRET_OTLP_AUTH_TOKEN_REF
variables.description: Reference to the environment's OTLP collector bearer token behind the telemetry exporter.
